title: 第19章 气运之子第20章 好算计
slug: 为了长生不死我带着全宗修仙
content_zh:
;;
“终于有人来了！”
宁青青看到寂月走过来，赶忙招手。
“姑娘，能不能来帮我一下，求求啦！”
寂月走近，系统响了。
【检测到合格未来弟子人选】
她没多犹豫，过去把人从地上扶了起来。
“真是太谢谢你了，要不是有你在，我都不知道什么时候才能出来。”宁青青揉了揉脚腕，随后从那个把她脚卡住的坑洞里，捡起了一枚戒指。
“这个给你，要不是因为你，我还得卡好久呢。”
空间戒指……
寂月盯着那枚戒指陷入了沉思。
【女，十四岁，土木灵根，资质上乘，运气极佳。注：气运之子，享天道所有的偏爱。】
这个土木灵根就很灵性啊。
怪不得卡个脚都能捡到空间戒指，原来是因为这个气运爆棚了啊！
寂月对此很嫉妒。
“不必了，那是你的东西，我只是恰好路过而已。”
宁青青挠了挠头，随后从荷包里拿出了十几个空间戒指，“这东西我有好多个，而且我也不知道是怎么用的。你要是不要的话，那我就找个地方扔了吧。”
小姑娘，放下你的机缘！
寂月一脸沉重地说：“要不，你丢的时候告诉我一下位置？”
“你知道这是什么东西？那都给你好了。”对方直接把荷包全递了过来。

这可是空间戒指，跟乾坤袋不一样，无论是里面的容量还是价值，都是不一样的。
而且还不容易掉。
收，还是不收？
在良心的谴责下，寂月还是把东西给收了。
送上门的机缘她还不要，脑子被驴踢了吧。
“你为何会在此处？这儿是什么地方，你知道吗？”寂月决定先把人带出去，这座山脉好像有点危险。
宁青青唔了一声，说：“这里是飓风山脉，因山中常年刮大风而得名。我家就在那边的山上，我从小就在这里长大。”
“从小在这里长大？”寂月惊讶地看着她。
如花一样的年纪，身上穿的衣服并不华丽，倒是像她入修仙一途之前穿的粗布麻衣。
她身上没有半点修为，一双眼睛不仅单纯，还透着一股清澈的愚蠢，可见她长这么大接触的人和事并不多。
野人？
不至于，看这一身干净的样子，应该是有家人带着的。
“你家在哪？我送你回去。”
这一路走来，有不少没开智的妖兽在这座山脉里晃荡，最低也是练气大圆满。
寂月可不敢打包票能护这孩子周全，她自己都不一定能保住自己。
宁青青听了之后，却摇了摇头，“我家已经没人了，所以我想看看外面的世界。但是我不知道怎么走出去，就不小心卡住了脚。”
这哪是不小心卡住了脚啊，那是天道上赶着给你喂机缘呢。
不过天道算错的是，这丫头根本就没修为，而且还过着与世隔绝的生活，哪里知道什么是空间戒指？
“正好我也想走出这座山脉，你跟我一起吧。”寂月暂时没提收徒的事，骗一个傻白甜，总感觉良心有点痛，虽然她也没有多少良心。

"Finally someone is here!"
Ning Qingqing saw Ji Yue approaching and hurriedly waved.
"Girl, can you come and help me, please!"
As Jiyue approached, the system rang.
[Qualified candidates for future disciples detected]
Without much hesitation, she went over and helped the person up from the ground.
"Thank you so much. If it weren't for you, I don't know when I would be able to come out." Ning Qingqing rubbed her ankle, and then picked up a ring from the hole where her foot was stuck.
"This is for you. If it weren't for you, I would still be stuck for a long time."
Space ring...
Jiyue stared at the ring and fell into deep thought.
[Female, fourteen years old, civilized spiritual roots, excellent qualifications, and excellent luck. Note: Children of luck enjoy all the favors of heaven. 】
This earth-wood spiritual root is very spiritual.
No wonder I can pick up a space ring even if my feet are stuck. It turns out it’s because of my incredible luck!
Jiyue was jealous of this.
"No need, that's your thing, I just happened to be passing by."
Ning Qingqing scratched her head, and then took out a dozen space rings from her purse, "I have many of these, and I don't know how to use them. If you don't want them, then I will find a place to throw them away."
Little girl, give up your chances!
Jiyue said with a serious face: "How about you tell me the location when you lost it?"
"Do you know what this is? It's all for you." The other party directly handed over the entire purse.
This is a space ring. It is different from the Qiankun Bag. Both the capacity and value inside are different.
And it’s not easy to fall off.
To accept or not to accept?
Condemned by her conscience, Jiyue still collected the things.
If she didn't want the opportunity that came to her, she might have been kicked in the head.
"Why are you here? Do you know what kind of place this is?" Jiyue decided to take people out first. This mountain range seemed a bit dangerous.
Ning Qingqing hesitated and said: "This is the Hurricane Mountain Range, so named because of the strong winds blowing in the mountains all year round. My home is on the mountain over there, and I have grown up here since I was a child."
"Growing up here?" Jiyue looked at her in surprise.
At Ruhua's age, the clothes she wears are not gorgeous, but look like the coarse linen clothes she wore before she entered the path of cultivating immortality.
She has no cultivation at all, and her eyes are not only simple, but also reveal a clear sense of stupidity, which shows that she has not been exposed to many people and things in her life.
Savage?
No, judging from his clean appearance, he must have been brought by his family.
"Where is your home? I will take you back."
Along the way, there were many unintelligent monsters wandering around in this mountain range, the lowest of which was the Great Perfection of Qi Training.
Jiyue didn't dare to guarantee that she could protect this child, and she might not even be able to protect herself.
After hearing this, Ning Qingqing shook her head, "There is no one in my house anymore, so I want to see the outside world. But I don't know how to get out, and I accidentally got my foot stuck."
It's not like you accidentally stuck your foot. It's because God is rushing to give you opportunities.
But what Tian Dao made wrong is that this girl has no cultivation at all, and she lives in isolation from the world. How does she know what a space ring is?
"It just so happens that I also want to get out of this mountain range. Come with me." Jiyue didn't mention the matter of accepting a disciple for the time being. She lied to a silly Baitian, and she always felt a little pain in her conscience, although she didn't have much conscience.
